comparison.objective: Screen ceramic finishing media from metal washers, versus piping a shell border in icing.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid granular separation versus continuous deformable-material extrusion with pressure, trajectory and shape control.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media mass and washer preservation versus sufficient valid ridged shells with clean surroundings.
comparison.reason: The record tests deposition and shaping of deformable material, not separation.
